channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Ace Bailey | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Ace Bailey from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Will Hardy on Ace Bailey
item.description:
Andy Larsen:Will Hardy on Ace Bailey’s hip injury:

“Yeah, it's still day to day. You know, he felt like he could go in OKC, and then after his first two shifts, we didn't love how he looked moving,he didn't love how he felt, and so we don't want to put him in a position that hurts him.”

Will Hardy on Ace Bailey, Jan 11, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Will Hardy on Ace Bailey
item.description:
Andy Larsen:Will Hardy on Ace Bailey injury:

“He's got some tendonitis in both knees. It's nothing that we're overly concerned with. He's not going to be getting imaged or anything like that. It's just trying to take care of him. He was a little sore during his second stint.”

Will Hardy on Ace Bailey, Oct 14, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Paul George on Cooper Flagg, Ace Bailey
item.description:
Paul George:

“I think Ace Bailey can scratch a little bit more off of his surface than Cooper Flagg can. Which I think both will be All-Stars, both will be superstars once they develop and get to the NBA. I think both will be superstars. I think those two will definitely be the Magic Johnson and Larry Bird comparison in terms of similar body types and the parody between those two. But I’m going to go with Ace Bailey.”

Paul George on Cooper Flagg, Ace Bailey, Feb 24, 2025. Source: Newark Star-Ledger.

item.title: Paul George on Ace Bailey
item.description:
Rutgers star Ace Bailey has a higher upside than Cooper Flagg, according to both Philadelphia 76ers star Paul George and former Stanford star and current Fox analyst Casey Jacobsen.

Paul George on Ace Bailey, Feb 24, 2025. Source: Newark Star-Ledger.
